C1698.title: Capital One Data Breach
C1698.summary: In 2019, a misconfigured AWS cloud storage allowed an attacker to exploit overly permissive API keys to access S3 buckets, exposing approximately 100 million customer records. The root cause was improper privilege management, where the attacker gained broader access than necessary, amplifying the breach impact.
